name: Rafael Souza
bio:
Rafael's fascination with motorsport began as a child, watching Ayrton Senna dominate Formula One. He honed his skills at a technical college in São Paulo before securing a role at a local racing team, specializing in engine components. His meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly made him a valuable asset. He believes in a hands-on approach, constantly seeking ways to improve efficiency and performance.

Rafael is known for his ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues quickly and effectively. While his demanding nature can sometimes ruffle feathers, his colleagues respect his unwavering commitment to quality and his willingness to share his expertise. He is always looking for a team where he can contribute to winning races and push the boundaries of engineering.

His innovation skills are quite high, and he constantly thinks of ways to improve the current car's performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Rafael is a lean man with strong hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a lucky wrench that he refuses to let anyone else use.
Drinks black coffee, no sugar, every two hours without fail.
